The main takeaway from our work is that
SWCNTs are an excellent solid-contact material for ClO4 − determination in all-solid-state ISEs and that InIII-porph is an efficient ion carrier for the development of such ISEs.
the proposed SWCNT-based ISE can be used for the rapid and accurate analysis of ClO4− in complex samples, such as firecrackers and propellants, without any pretreatment.
the proposed SWCNT-based ClO4− ISE is a reliable, robust, and cost-effective alternative for perchlorate analysis.
